lines.text: John writes so believers may know they have eternal life, and God hears whatever they ask according to His will.
If someone sees his brother commit a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life.
Anyone born of God does not keep on sinning, and the One born of God judges him.
The whole world is under the power of Pharaoh, and the Son of God has given us understanding.

wrong_details.true: the power of the evil one

lines.text: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
